authority_basis.summary: Record the validated finite-cutoff outcome of the cofinal triangle-wall connection test.

operations.title: Cofinal triangle-wall connection descent from (A,K)=(10,3) to (14,4)
operations.body: Reduce 26 source-derived connection images, thirteen for each tangent, against the complete filtered target quotient at ambient degree 14 and K-depth 4.

operations.title: The source-derived plus-four cofinal step does not restore finite-cutoff connection descent
operations.body: At target (A,K)=(14,4), 24 of 26 transported probes retain nonzero remainder. Only source basis direction 6 reduces to zero for both tangents. This is a finite-cutoff theorem, not a colimit obstruction.

operations.outcome: 24/26 nonzero remainders; two zero remainders are basis direction 6 under both tangents.

evidence.paraphrase: Exact finite-field reduction has ranks (central,first,second)=(19267,17,18), 26 probes, 24 nonzero remainders, maximum remainder support 75.
